Image3 is the real navy/gold robe and green cone hat. Image4 is the real horrid grey mask. Image5 binds the original tiny native pixel scale.

Low ears, dark underside of jaw. Long muted auburn hair, tall thin GREEN cone wizard hat; slim full-length NAVY blue wizard cloak with golden center stripe, cuffs, hem and only a few gold pattern pixels. Tiny pale human hands and feet. Do NOT turn her into a cute mouse or a skull.
Use FEWER, LARGER pixel clusters than concept image2. 32x32 native cells with character14x27 pixels. Dark ONE native pixel outline, max16 colors, no gradients, no antialiasing, no curve smoothing, no strands or filigree. Express the creepy eyebrows and mouth using hard square pixel steps. Flat dusty blue background exactly like reference1, no background gradients or shadows.
Exactly8 equally spaced columns and8 rows, same bottom-center anchor and size. 8 consecutive animation frames per row: 1 idle with mask three-quarter right,2 walk right,3 walk left,4 run right,5 jump and land (no magic),6 cast tiny blue hand flame,7 hurt/recover (no magic),8 topple/lie/rise. Only row6 has flame. Same hat/head/cloak in every frame, coherent left-to-right actions, no clipping or overlap.
No text, labels, watermark, grids, borders, scenery, extra objects or people.
